events.title: The Joy of Birding: Summer
events.description:
Have you already been out exploring birds in the field but would like to learn more about the identification nuances between similar species? Are you interested in delving deeper into understanding bird behaviour, adaptations, and migration? If these questions ring true for you, then “The Joy of Birding” is the program for you!

Join Barry, Angelique and other birders as we together explore the use of field marks, behaviour, taxonomy, timing, calls, songs, and habitat preferences to identify species in the field. To provide you with a high quality experience, each session is kept to a small group size of 12 registrants. Sessions take place in a variety of habitats on RBG lands, including the Arboretum, Hendrie Valley, Laking Garden, Princess Point, or the Aviary. 3 hours long, for more experienced birders.

events.title: Matthew Good and His Band
events.description:
This fall, Matthew Good and His Band take the stage in a uniquely immersive live experience, joined by a stunning string quartet led by renowned cellist Kevin Fox. Across two dynamic 45-minute sets, the evening weaves together beloved hits, deep cuts, and rare B-sides, reimagined through a rich interplay of acoustic intimacy and full-band intensity.

events.title: Michael Kaeshammer
events.description:
Michael Kaeshammer isn’t so much a piano player as a piano whisperer, a master musician and songwriter able to coax dazzling, kaleidoscopic sounds from his instrument in a way few can rival.

Across a brilliant, globe-trotting career highlighted by nine tours of China, three appearances at the Olympics, and countless shows opposite international superstars, the German-born, B.C.-based Kaeshammer has electrified audiences with his indelible repertoire and consistently positive outlook on life which infuses his lyrics. “I am a very positive person,” confirms the seven-time JUNO Award nominee and unabashed foodie, who hosts cooking show Kaeshammer’s Kitchen on Vancouver Island’s CHEK TV. “I really love playing shows and being on-stage. If Turn It Up helps me to do more of that, then I’m all in. Music is my favourite thing to do.”

events.title: Sarah Harmer
events.description:
Sarah Harmer is a multiple award-winning, platinum-selling singer-songwriter and environmental activist.

A deeply personal and political collection of songs motivated by the beauty of life, the urgency of the climate crisis, and the question of loss, Sarah called the album a spiritual successor of sorts to her acclaimed 2000 debut. Its simple title, Are You Gone, is a meditation on presence and a bookend to the questions posed on You Were Here – a sharpened, more electric confrontation with the realities of nature and human nature.

Between co-founding the citizen’s organization PERL (Protecting Escarpment Rural Land) and leading the successful effort to prevent an open-pit gravel mine in a UNESCO World Biosphere

Reserve on the Niagara Escarpment, Sarah has become a fixture in local politics and advocacy.

In 2022, Sarah helped launch the Reform Gravel Mining Coalition in her home province of Ontario to protect water, farmland, and biodiversity. She is currently writing songs for a new album.

events.description: Feel the spirit of the season come alive and begin a holiday tradition with Myriad. Share the moment with family and friends and explore the many expressions of tradition – old, new and reimagined. events.title: Holly Cole Swinging Christmas
events.description: Celebrate the season with the unmistakable voice of Holly Cole. Blending jazz, pop, and country influences, Cole’s warm and intimate holiday concert promises an evening of festive charm and musical sparkle.

events.title: The Next Generation Leahy
events.description:
Experience the magic of Christmas with Next Generation Leahy! Made up of siblings, this Canadian Celtic powerhouse delivers a performance that is truly unforgettable.

Each member is a multi-instrumentalist, where exuberant talent, passion, and energy come together to form a truly special performance. Inspired by the rich tapestry of Celtic, Irish, Jazz, French Canadian, Pop, Country, Swing Music, and many other styles, Next Generation Leahy infuses these influences into a fresh and vibrant sound that is distinctly their own. Their performances are intense, polished, and overflowing with emotion, captivating audiences with fiery instrumentals, intricate harmonies, and dynamic step dancing.

Designed for audiences of all ages, this authentic, spirited, and joy filled performance is sure to be highly entertaining. Providing a balance of both Christmas classics and their own celtic based music, this performance highlights the joy music can bring to the season. Next Generation Leahy invites you to gather with family and friends to come experience a magical and inspiring evening.

events.title: A Very Charlie Brown Christmas Concert
events.description:

This heartwarming performance features music from the album performed by Adam Bowman on drums, Duncan Wilson on piano, and Tyler Wagler on bass. The trio is accompanied by Burlington’s own Enchorus Children’s Choir.

events.description:
For the first time, Whitehorse hits the road as a true family band in a special evening celebrating two decades of music together. Known for their soulful blend of folk-rock, raw storytelling, and magnetic onstage chemistry, Luke Doucet and Melissa McClelland return with songs from their new album All I Want Is All of It, bringing their signature sound to life with longtime collaborator John Obercian on drums and their son Jimi Doucet on keys.

Making the night even more special, their daughter Chloë Doucet – an emerging Toronto singer-songwriter – joins the performance with her own songs and as part of the band on guitar and vocals. The result is an intimate and expansive live show that feels less like a concert and more like a joyful family celebration of music, connection, and twenty years of Whitehorse.

events.title: Sing-a-long The Greatest Showman
events.description: Step right up and sing along to the smash-hit movie musical The Greatest Showman! Featuring unforgettable songs like ‘This Is Me,’ ‘A Million Dreams,’ and ‘The Greatest Show,’ this special screening invites audiences to belt out every lyric together. Gather your friends, warm up your voice, and experience the joy, spectacle, and soaring music of this beloved film in a lively sing-along celebration.

events.title: Chris Funk The Wonderist: Redefining Wonder
events.description:
Chris Funk’s REDEFINING WONDER is an engaging and visceral multimedia experience that has audiences talking and scratching their heads for years to come. Finally, a MAGIC SHOW WITH LIVE MUSIC! Chris has pioneered the use of instruments like the violin, guitar, flute and more into his illusions. His parents wanted him to be a musician, but he wanted to be a magician. Chris tells his story on how he integrated his love for music and magic in a show unlike any other. Whether it’s a violin concerto to a magical dancing sheet of music to impossibly suspending various instruments on stage, his show is in a league of its own. The live-feed camera and interactive videos bring audiences up onstage and into the action, delivering a show that family audiences can call their own.

From NBC’s America’s Got Talent, CW’s Penn & Teller: Fool Us & Masters of Illusion, FOX’s Hell’s Kitchen and Syfy’s Wizard Wars, his unique approach to magic has garnered him performances at Las Vegas’ Planet Hollywood, Mandalay Bay, Rio, and Tropicana casinos as well as residencies at Disney. events.description: Prepare for an evening of sonic discovery as Canada’s Gryphon Trio—three-time Juno Award winners—collaborates with the phenomenal Norwegian vocal sextet Nordic Voices. From the heart-wrenching lyricism of Dvořák’s Dumky Trio to breathtaking a cappella works rooted in global folk traditions, this program spotlights bold new music by Andrew Balfour (Cree), Norbert Palej, and Bohdana Frolyak. It’s an extraordinary cross-cultural encounter filled with passion, precision, and artistry.

events.title: Live & Local: Songwriter’s Circle & Open Mic
events.description:
Experience the best of local music in this intimate and welcoming evening that brings together storytelling, song, and community. Hosted by Hamilton-based singer-songwriter Chelsea McWilliams of Red Hill Valleys, Live & Local begins with a curated songwriters’ circle featuring talented regional artists sharing original songs, the stories behind them, and the inspirations that shape their work.

Then, the stage opens up. Emerging and amateur performers are invited to step into the spotlight during an open mic session, with the opportunity to share their music in a supportive, collaborative environment. Select participants may even receive feedback and insight from the featured artists, creating a unique mentorship experience.

From seasoned songwriters to first-time performers, Live & Local is a celebration of the creativity thriving in our region. Whether you’re performing or simply soaking it all in, this is where local voices are heard, supported, and celebrated.

events.title: Girls Nite Out Comedy Troupe
events.description: Girls Nite Out returns for another jam-packed night of laughter and unforgettable fun. Hosted by the fearless and hilarious Canadian comedic icon Elvira Kurt, this all-female comedy showcase brings together some of Canada’s funniest stand-up and improv performers for an evening of bold, high-energy comedy. Featuring Canadian Comedy Award winners, Second City alumni, and CBC comedy favourites, the show mixes sharp stand-up with spontaneous improv inspired by audience suggestions, meaning no two performances are ever the same. Gather your friends and get ready for a night of big laughs, outrageous stories, and unstoppable comedic talent that will have you laughing long after the curtain falls.

events.title: TAIKOPROJECT 25th Anniversary Concert
events.description:
TAIKOPROJECT’s powerful drumming unites ancient Japanese tradition with 21st century American innovation to create a riot of movement and thundering rhythm. It’s been called a tsunami of sound but this highly charged ensemble is so much more. This show will ignite all of your senses with a spellbinding mix of music, theater and precision. The group received international acclaim when they became the first American ensemble to win the prestigious Tokyo International Taiko Contest. Since then, they have wowed audiences at the Academy Awards and the Grammys with their grace, energy and passion.

TAIKOPROJECT first made waves when they became the first American taiko group to win the prestigious Tokyo International Taiko Contest in 2005, besting all of the Japanese taiko groups in the competition. That year, they were cast in the Mitsubishi Eclipse commercial, the first and still only national advertising campaign to prominently feature taiko. Since then, the group has performed on the 2009 Academy Awards, the 2011 Grammy Awards, NBC’s “The Voice,” Syfy’s Face/Off, The X-Factor, and were honored with the prestigious Visionary Award from East West Players. events.title: Toronto Jazz Orchestra
events.description: The Toronto Jazz Orchestra is one of Canada’s premier big bands, bringing the thrilling sound of big band jazz to audiences since 1998. This dynamic 18-piece ensemble performs music by many of the most important composers in jazz while also championing outstanding Canadian writers and arrangers. Led by founder, Artistic Director, and conductor Josh Grossman, the orchestra’s repertoire spans classic swing to bold contemporary jazz, performed with exceptional energy and precision. A regular presence on Toronto’s vibrant jazz scene and at festivals and concert halls across Ontario, the Toronto Jazz Orchestra is celebrated for its powerful live performances that both honour the rich tradition of big band music and bring it vividly to life for today’s audiences.

events.title: Justin Shaw – The 70 Mile Yard Sale
events.description:
Get ready for a larger than life story about Canada’s smallest province.

Through countless laughs, comedian and storyteller Justin Shaw transports his audience to Prince Edward for a madcap journey to retrieve a lost family heirloom at a gargantuan yard sale.

Inspired by Prince Edward Island’s 70 Mile Coastal Yard Sale, THE 70 MILE YARD SALE is a one person show that is equal parts funny and heartfelt, and Shaw expertly spins a fun-filled yarn about family, community, and finding more than you bargained for.

Written and Performed by Justin Shaw

Show times at 1pm and 4pm

events.title: A Brief History of Smoking Cigarettes
events.description: A Brief History of Smoking Cigarettes follows Deanna’s personal history with cigarettes, and, quite impossibly, THE ENTIRE GLOBAL HISTORY of cigarettes, in a touching and hilarious one-woman show that uses puppets, live music, and video to convey how SPECTACULAR the play will be when it eventually gets funded by “Big Tobacco.” Sharing true stories, wide-reaching musings and playful audience interaction, this multi-dimensional show shines a light on how one of the biggest and ugliest industries changed the world and influenced Deanna’s life. Through the polarizing puffpull of a cigarette, this play explores themes of colonization, capitalism, and the commodification of a sacred natural resource.

events.title: International Guitar Night
events.description: International Guitar Night, the world’s premier touring acoustic guitar festival, is thrilled to announce its return for a national Canadian tour in January/February 2027. IGN has a deep history in Canada, having launched on the West Coast and maintained a solid presence for over two decades. This 2027 tour will be nationwide, with a lineup that continues IGN’s tradition of bringing audiences the best acoustic guitarists from around the world. The show, which has a compelling history of sold-out performances in Canadian theaters, brings together Brazilian, Flamenco, Middle Eastern and Gypsy jazz influences.

events.title: Shakura S’Aida
events.description: Shakura S’Aida is an acclaimed Americana roots-soul singer/songwriter, three-time JUNO Award nominee, and recurring actor on Schitt’s Creek. Brooklyn-born, Swiss-raised, and Toronto-based, she is celebrated for her powerful, soul-stirring voice and dynamic live performances that have captivated audiences in 31 countries. Her latest single, “Keep It Movin’,” follows her JUNO-nominated, Folk Canada Award–winning album Hold On to Love. A dedicated community builder for over 40 years, S’Aida also curates concerts and festivals through Shakura S’Aida Presents, creating meaningful connections between artists and audiences across North America and Europe.

events.title: Men Without Hats w/ Special Guests
events.description: Get ready for a night of pure 80s nostalgia when Men Without Hats and Spoons take the stage at BPAC! Dance the night away to the synth-pop anthems that defined a generation, including Men Without Hats’ global smash “The Safety Dance”, alongside hometown heroes Spoons, Burlington’s own new wave legends behind hits like “Romantic Traffic”and “Nova Heart.” Packed with infectious hooks, retro energy, and sing-along favourites, this electrifying double bill is the ultimate throwback party – so gather your friends, celebrate a hometown band, and get ready to dance all night long.

events.title: Hold On To Your Butts
events.description:
65 million years ago, dinosaurs ruled the earth…30 years ago, a movie about dinosaurs ruled the box office…

This year, you are invited to… Hold On To Your Butts

Following its critically acclaimed West End and Off-Broadway debuts, the smash hit show goes on tour!

Two actors and a Foley artist perform a live, shot-for-shot parody of the greatest dinosaur film of all time. A wildly inventive tour-de-force of comedy, physical theatre and live Foley.

events.title: In Spite of Ourselves: An Evening of John Prine
events.description: Celebrate the timeless songs of one of America’s greatest storytellers. This heartfelt tribute honours the wit, warmth, and unforgettable songwriting of the legendary John Prine, bringing his beloved catalogue to life through a night of beautifully performed classics. From the humour and charm of “In Spite of Ourselves” to the poignant poetry of “Angel from Montgomery” and “Hello in There,” audiences will be transported by the songs that made Prine a cherished voice in folk and country music. Whether you’re a lifelong fan or discovering his music for the first time, this special evening celebrates the enduring spirit and humanity of John Prine’s extraordinary songwriting.

events.title: HOW COULD YOU, MRS. DICK?
events.description:
Based on a true story, How Could You, Mrs. Dick? follows the rise and scrutiny of Evelyn Dick, a woman at the center of a sensationalized public scandal. As reporters attempt to uncover the truth, Evelyn becomes both subject and spectacle. Charismatic and complex, Evelyn navigates the blurred line between truth and perception as those around her attempt to define her. At its core, the play explores the making of a public figure—and the cost of being at the center of it.

By Douglas Rodger

Directed by: Matt Willson, Produced by: Julie Donoahue

With the help of an old Baobab tree and a mysterious beaded calabash, Yassama learns to understand the limits of the nature that sustains her.

Blending African oral tradition, theatre, and dance, Yassama and the Beaded Calabash is a timeless ecological and spiritual tale. More than a search for water, the story reveals the sacred bond between people and Mother Earth, celebrating perseverance, humility, and shared responsibility.

events.title: Hamlet – Teatro la Plaza
events.description:
A powerful reimagining of Hamlet like no other. Eight actors with Down syndrome take the stage to share their desires, struggles, and questions through this bold adaptation of Shakespeare’s classic. Blending the original text with the personal stories of the performers, the play begins with one of the most profound questions ever asked: ‘To be or not to be?’ But here, it’s not just a line, it’s a lived experience.

What does it mean to be in a world that often overlooks you? In a society obsessed with productivity, beauty, and perfection, this production challenges us to rethink who gets to belong, and what it truly means to live a meaningful life.

BPAC is proud to collaborate with colleagues to bring this company from Peru on a national tour in Spring 2027.

events.description: When Matt Andersen takes the stage, his powerhouse voice and masterful guitar playing command the room. The New Brunswick–born singer-songwriter delivers soulful performances that move effortlessly from intimate folk to electrifying blues and roots, captivating audiences with both tenderness and raw energy. His latest album, The Hammer & The Rose, showcases Andersen’s thoughtful songwriting and deep emotional range, exploring life’s most meaningful moments through stirring melodies and heartfelt lyrics. A tireless touring artist, Andersen has performed on stages around the world and built a devoted international following through his unforgettable live shows. With multiple awards to his name and millions of streams across platforms, Matt Andersen continues to be one of Canada’s most compelling voices in contemporary roots music.

As reporters attempt to uncover the truth, Evelyn becomes both subject and spectacle. Charismatic and complex, Evelyn navigates the blurred line between truth and perception as those around her attempt to define her. At its core, the play explores the making of a public figure—and the cost of being at the center of it.

events.title: The Other Mozart – The forgotten story of Mozart’s genius sister
events.description:
The forgotten story of Mozart’s genius sister.

The Other Mozart is an award-winning, Drama Desk nominated play telling the true, forgotten story of Nannerl Mozart, the genius sister of Amadeus, who performed throughout Europe alongside him to equal acclaim, but her work and her story faded away, lost to history.

Set in a stunning 18-foot dress, inspired by the Mozart family’s hilarious and heartbreaking letters, this award-winning production by playwright Sylvia Milo ushers you into a world of opulence and delight – obscured by restriction and prejudice. Music score by Nathan Davis and Phyllis Chen (Lincoln Center’s Mostly Mozart Festival) brings Nannerl’s musical imagination to life using clavichords, music boxes, teacups and fluttering fans.

With the opulent beauty of the dress, the sweet smell of perfume, the sublime enveloping sound and the clouds of dusting powder rising from the stage, the performance creates a multi-sensual experience. There, in communion with the audience, this other Mozart at last tells her story.

events.title: Emerald Isle – A Joyful Celebration of Irish Music, Song and Dance
events.description:
Fresh from its World Premiere, where Emerald Isle received a 5 Star review, this world’s first in Irish music, song and dance takes us around the 32 counties of the island of Ireland. Emerald Isle is a breath taking live show that transports audiences on a magical journey through the heart and soul of Ireland. Created by the visionary producer Chris Hannon, former Lord of the Dance Star and creator of the global sensation Murphy’s Celtic Legacy, this extraordinary performance celebrates the rich tapestry of Irish culture, from its vibrant traditions to its mythical stories and ancient sites.

Witness world-class dancers, musicians, and singers come together to create an unforgettable experience that captures the essence of Ireland’s 32 counties. Immerse yourself in the rhythm of traditional Irish music, be captivated by the energy of electrifying dance performances, and be moved by the heartfelt melodies of Irish song.

Emerald Isle is more than just a show; it’s an invitation to experience the magic of Ireland first hand. Prepare to be enchanted as we bring the Emerald Isle to life on stage.

events.title: Erth’s Shark Dive
events.description:
It’s a shark dive, but not as you know it!

Delve deep to discover what swims beneath the surface.

Come face to face with an array of enchanting sea life that has existed from deep within our prehistoric past to the rich biodiversity that now inhabits the world’s oceans.

Presented as a live poetic documentary, the exquisite puppets of Erth’s Shark Dive will enchant and delight, and challenge you to reconsider our own role in protecting these much maligned magnificent creatures.

You won’t encounter any Hollywood jump scares here: you will be surprised at how beautiful these creatures actually are. Take the risk and have your expectations turned upside down!

Encounter bull sharks, grey nurses and the majestic great white shark in this tantalising underwater experience from one of Australia’s foremost visual theatre companies.

Erth’s Shark Dive was originally commissioned for the Australian Museum, and has been presented at the Australian National Maritime Museum, Sydney Festival and Brisbane Festival before touring the USA.
